name: acryl-kv
description: The kv port: named JSON documents for an app too small for SQL, with atomic update; types, checks and copyKv (the import). A provider (acryl-kv-json, acryl-kv-db) serves it. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: it is the port, not a service: a plugin declares inject: ['kv'] and imports the ctx.kv type from '../plugins/acryl-kv/src/cordis.ts'; add acryl-kv-json (a file) or acryl-kv-db (your SQL database) to provide it
